scope: Targeted manual reading of highest-risk and near-duplicate public pages after all-571 automated WordPress post scan
warning: These specific judgments do NOT cover the remaining sitewide posts; automatic 0-100 priority is not factual/editorial grade. No WordPress posts edited.

reviewed.finding: About 166 body words. Appropriate caution about not applying US PHEV numbers to Egypt, but lacking manufacturer source links, detailed battery/charging/safety testing and model-year context; title promises specs and maintenance well beyond what the page delivers.
reviewed.recommendation: Manually research BMW official 2026 X5 PHEV sources by market then repair if confirmed below editorial 80 threshold.

reviewed.finding: About 360 body words. Correctly rejects fabricated 5k/10k intervals and warns about 4AT vs CVT; nevertheless no linked Egyptian Nissan primary schedule or actual table-by-interval. Searcher looking for جدول صيانة will not receive one.
reviewed.recommendation: Verify exact Egypt Nissan model-year maintenance table and create real schedules with sources or update page title/intent.

reviewed.finding: About 271 body words. Generic P0171/P0300/P0420/VVT primer, factually cautious but not a comprehensive Toyota DTC dictionary; no manufacturer references or deep diagnostic pathways.
reviewed.recommendation: Compare against stronger existing Corolla/brand DTC content to avoid cannibalization before expansion or canonical changes.

reviewed.finding: About 559 body words despite a comprehensive engine guide title, relies heavily on metaphors, does not systematically cover 4 strokes and actual powertrain mechanisms or primary technical references.
reviewed.recommendation: Rebuild as a proper illustrated educational chapter rather than append generic filler.

reviewed.finding: About 398 body words. Has useful comparison table and reasonable caveats, but lacks Egypt-specific ownership costs, practical legal/registration comparisons and manufacturer-based maintenance; no sources.
reviewed.recommendation: Recheck user shopping intent, validate local prices and legal claims before editing.

reviewed.finding: Text is identical to /radiator-internal-blockage-flow-temperature-test/; live canonical already points at the primary non--2 URL. Do not assume duplicate indexed, requires GSC/index check.
reviewed.recommendation: Avoid blind 301; compare GSC indexed/search performance and internal links first.

reviewed.finding: Live same title/text as /dtc-p0342-chevrolet/ and canonical already targets /dtc-p0342-chevrolet/. Original contains meaningful electrical diagnostics and cited official-related TSBs. Similarity is duplication of URLs, not proof that article content is poor.
reviewed.recommendation: Inspect GSC and internal linking; no rewrite based on duplicate score.

reviewed.finding: Live canonical points to Arabic Chevrolet P0300 source; near-identical diagnostic text and real EPA reference. Do not automatically merge or rewrite; evaluate keyword intent and performance.
reviewed.recommendation: Check GSC and sitemap/canonical routes before redirects.
